svg.title: Smart AI Resume Analyzer Pro — project 04.1
svg.desc: Smart AI Resume Analyzer Pro — AI-powered resume screening & career recommendation system. Features: ATS score & resume grade; Skill + missing-skill detection; Job match percentage; Career readiness score; Section analysis & interview questions; Radar / pie charts · PDF report. Tech: Python, Streamlit, PyPDF2, NumPy, Matplotlib, ReportLab. Repository: github.com/thedenilsonpinto/Smart-AI-Resume-Analyzer-Pro.
